# Durable Field Notes

Capture only the friction points and verified solutions that would otherwise be rediscovered at cost.

## Record

- Specific commands and option combinations confirmed effective in this environment.
- Hard constraints that emerged from real failures and cannot be relaxed.
- Behavioral anomalies in tools that influenced correctness (argument sensitivity, quoting rules, endpoint priority).

## Retire

- General-purpose references unconnected to this project's specifics.
- Observations already derivable from the commit log or existing annotations.
- Padded explanations that restate instructions without adding new information.

## Supersession Rule

When evidence contradicts a prior note, the prior note is replaced — not supplemented. Stale and current guidance must not occupy the same record.

## Verification Principle

Prove correctness through the project's own automated or manual checks. Limit the scope of modifications to what the stated goal demands.
